create_SQuAD_with_context: create a SQuAD dataset instance in with_context mode to include context with questions
create_SQuAD_no_context: create a SQuAD dataset instance in no_context mode to use questions only
run_SQuAD_preprocessing: run the main function to generate k-shot data for all modes and seeds
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace SQuAD dataset split to a list of question-answer tuples
load_dataset_SQuAD: load the SQuAD dataset from HuggingFace using datasets.load_dataset
